must_not_edit: any MLS client / group-state backend code (S1 single active client is out of scope)

behaviour: B1: crossTab.ts owns the only BroadcastChannel('few-tabs'); messages are {type:'store-changed', store, id?} with store in blocked|known|contacts|groups|chat|polls; malformed messages are dropped on receipt.
B2: posting and listening share one channel object, so a tab never receives its own posts; without window or BroadcastChannel every call is a silent no-op; postStoreChanged never throws.

B3: writers post only after their storage write succeeded: archive/unarchiveContact -> contacts + blocked; any contacts/contactCache write -> contacts; knownPeers write -> known; saveGroup/deleteGroup/clearAllGroupMeta -> groups(id); chat append/update/tombstone/remove/clear -> chat(groupId), only when a row changed; savePoll / saveVoteIfNewer (when it wrote) -> polls(groupId). A thrown/rejected write posts nothing; a throwing post never fails the write.

B4: MarmotContext subscribes once and maps: blocked->blockedPeersRevision, known->knownPeersRevision, contacts->contactsRevision, groups->reloadGroups()+groupDataVersion, chat->chatVersion, polls->pollVersion; actions never write; subscription released on unmount and the channel closed with the last listener.
B5: e2e — two pages of one browser context: blocking in page 1 closes page 2's open thread with that contact and hides the contact there, without a reload; unblocking brings it back.
non_goals: Cross-tab MLS coordination / single active client (design S1, blocked on owner decisions).
Reactions: the reactions store serves reads from an in-memory cache, so a cross-tab bump alone would not refresh it; not wired in S0.
Rumor journal, pending poll queues, member profiles, account-wide clears of messages/polls: no displayed reload hook.
